core.title: V Shaped Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull, Omnia 9532

text.description_html:
Omnia 9532 "V" Style Brushed Stainless Steel Finish Cabinet Pull

The "V" shaped Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull made by Omnia is 2/5 inch (10mm) in diameter. This stainless steel cabinet hardware will maintain its rich luster for the lifetime of your home. The ridges on the pull give this cabinet handle a utilitarian look. Available in 2 sizes: 3-3/4 inch and 5 inch, both of which come in a brushed stainless steel finish.

Since this contemporary cabinet pull is so easy to clean it will maintain a smooth, rich luster for the lifetime of your home; and just like all Omnia's stainless steel cabinet handles, the modern styled pull will prove worthy of the exceptional standards that Omnia has sustained for more than 40 years.

Available in 2 Sizes:

  • OMN-9532/96 - Center to Center Hole Spacing: 3-3/4", Projection: 1-3/16"
  • OMN-9532/128 - Center to Center Hole Spacing: 5", Projection: 1-1/4"

    • Sold Individually
